Python-based Prophet-to-Excel formula conversion tool using binomial-tree algorithms — 50%+ reduction in manual actuarial model conversion time.
Automated Python web-scraping pipeline for bond yield cross-checking — up to 80% reduction in ingestion time with accurate recording.

projects.title: Blue-Devil-ChatBot
projects.description: A LangGraph assistant that retrieves Duke information through APIs, targeted scraping, and open-web search.

star.situation: Duke knowledge retrieval spans existing APIs, university webpages, and information on the wider web.
star.task: Build a conversational assistant that selects and coordinates the appropriate retrieval tools for each request.
star.action: Built a LangGraph workflow with LangChain, API calls, BeautifulSoup-based scraping, and Tavily search, presented through a Streamlit interface.
star.result: Delivered a chatbot that combines targeted retrieval with open-web search in one agentic workflow, bringing tool orchestration and search reasoning into the same experience.

projects.title: Text-to-SQL · DeepSeek LoRA
projects.description: A memory-efficient DeepSeek LoRA pipeline for text-to-SQL generation on the BIRD benchmark.

star.situation: Text-to-SQL adaptation was constrained by GPU memory, while everyday analytics required better execution accuracy on simple queries.
star.task: Fine-tune a distilled DeepSeek model on BIRD without out-of-memory failures or a regression on medium-difficulty queries.
star.action: Combined LoRA with an Unsloth training pipeline, 8-bit quantization, and Bfloat16 mixed precision to reduce memory pressure and stabilize convergence.
star.result: Improved execution accuracy by 50% on simple queries while maintaining medium-difficulty performance. The approach prioritized these everyday queries, with a trade-off on the hardest cases.

projects.title: Pido-AI-Pet
projects.description: A Raspberry Pi companion robot combining owner tracking, voice commands, expressive motion, and an LCD face.

star.situation: A physical AI companion needs to connect perception, interaction, and expressive movement on a small computing platform.
star.task: Create a Raspberry Pi 4B pet robot that follows its owner, responds to voice commands, and communicates emotion.
star.action: Integrated OpenCV/ArUco tracking, ultrasonic sensing, speech recognition, and camera/microphone inputs with a battery-powered chassis, servo-driven tail, and LCD display.
star.result: Delivered a working companion robot that follows its owner, reacts to spoken commands, and expresses emotions through its screen and movement.

projects.title: Stock-Market-Transformer
projects.description: A stock-forecasting pipeline combining market-state embeddings, a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer, and a Streamlit app.

star.situation: Short-horizon stock prediction requires a model that can represent market state alongside temporal price patterns.
star.task: Connect market-state representation learning to a forecasting model and make its predictions accessible in an application.
star.action: Built autoencoder-based market-state embeddings and a PyTorch Transformer with Mixture-of-Experts and multi-head attention, then connected the pipeline to Streamlit.
star.result: Deployed a working application for short-horizon opening-price forecasts. Broader prediction targets and lower loss remained areas for further development.

projects.title: Dual-Stream-Emotion-XAI
projects.description: An explainability dashboard comparing acoustic emotion and semantic sentiment in speech.

star.situation: How someone sounds and what they say can convey different emotions, including conflicting signals such as sarcasm.
star.task: Make acoustic and semantic model outputs inspectable side by side, including the structure of their latent representations.
star.action: Combined Wav2Vec2 acoustic emotion analysis with Whisper transcription and RoBERTa sentiment analysis. Used PCA and Plotly to present both streams as interactive 3D embeddings in Streamlit.
star.result: Delivered a dashboard for exploring clusters, nearest neighbors, and cross-modal conflicts, helping users examine where tone and wording agree or diverge.

projects.title: Sentinel-AI
projects.description: A blockchain wallet risk-scoring engine built for large-scale anti-money-laundering analysis.

star.situation: The project targeted 1B+ on-chain transactions across USDT/USDC flows representing approximately $2.9T in monthly volume.
star.task: Identify high-risk blockchain wallets in real time using transaction, smart-contract, and KYC signals.
star.action: Combined BigQuery-scale feature extraction with gradient-boosted models, drawing features from transaction graphs, smart-contract relationships, and KYC activity.
star.result: Delivered an AI-driven wallet risk-scoring engine and received the Academic Award at the 2025 FINOS DTCC Hackathon.

projects.title: FlashBack
projects.description: A Raspberry Pi lifelogging assistant that makes past in-person interactions searchable with multimodal AI.

star.situation: First-person audio and video can preserve encounters, but recalling who was there, what was discussed, and when requires a searchable memory interface.
star.task: Connect wearable-style capture, cloud storage, and natural-language retrieval in an end-to-end personal assistant.
star.action: Used a Raspberry Pi with a camera and microphone to capture lifelog video. Built a Flask and GCP backend to synchronize recordings and expose a Gemini-powered query API.
star.result: Enabled users to query past in-person interactions and won first place in the Education track at the 2024 Duke AI Hackathon.

projects.title: Gosvea Agentic RAG Chatbot
projects.description: Gosvea’s first production AI support channel, combining retrieval, multiple LLMs, and task-specific tools.

star.situation: Gosvea needed its first AI support channel for recurring course questions, course availability, and certificate requests.
star.task: Build a production assistant grounded in internal manuals, with tools to complete common support requests.
star.action: Connected Chatwoot and n8n to a LangChain multi-LLM pipeline on Groq. Built a Pinecone knowledge base with embeddings, query augmentation, and weekly curation; added real-time zip/date course search and e-certificate retrieval.
star.result: Achieved approximately 80% autonomous resolution, reduced simple email inquiries by 40%, and reached a 280:1 revenue-to-token-cost ratio.

projects.imageAlt: Concept illustration of a support conversation connected to a knowledge library and agent tools.

projects.title: Gosvea Scheduling Platform
projects.description: A deployed scheduling platform coordinating instructors across AHA and ARC certification programs.

star.situation: Parallel AHA and ARC certification programs required coordinated scheduling and reliable hand-offs between coordinators and instructors.
star.task: Create a shared workflow for calendar management, instructor identity, and scheduling notifications.
star.action: Designed and deployed a Spring Boot, React, and MySQL platform on AWS EC2, with a drag-and-drop calendar, automated instructor notifications, and a unified instructor-ID system.
star.result: Cut scheduling cycle time by more than 50% and eliminated classes of coordinator-to-instructor hand-off errors through the shared workflow.

projects.imageAlt: Concept illustration of a scheduling calendar with linked instructors and course sessions.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Slide Architect
projects.description: A multi-agent presentation builder that retrieves authorized evidence and iteratively assembles HTML slides.

star.situation: Automated presentations needed to draw from authorized source material while avoiding costly full-system reruns during revision.
star.task: Generate structured presentations from approved Pinecone sources and route feedback to the components that needed revision.
star.action: Built a LangGraph workflow for intent understanding, query expansion, hybrid retrieval, and reranking. A constructor generated HTML layouts, while a Reviewer-Assembler loop checked content and used conditional routing for targeted revisions.
star.result: The project evaluation reported 96% factual precision and over 40% less redundant compute than full-system resets, while restricting retrieval to authorized sources.

projects.imageAlt: Concept illustration of multiple agents assembling and reviewing a presentation deck.

projects.title: Clinical Claim Verifier with RAG
projects.description: A multimodal RAG workflow for finding and evaluating evidence behind influenza-vaccine clinical claims.

star.situation: Influenza-vaccine claim verification required extracting relevant evidence from documents whose layout and visual content affected interpretation.
star.task: Build a retrieval and verification workflow, then examine how confidence thresholds changed its evaluation results.
star.action: Combined Gemini Vision and ChromaDB with layout-aware parsing, contextual chunking, hybrid retrieval, and multi-stage reranking. Used an LLM-as-judge workflow and cross-model sensitivity analysis.
star.result: The project evaluation reported 100% overall accuracy at a 0.9 confidence threshold and 77% at 0.95, informing the choice of operating point for this evaluated dataset.

projects.imageAlt: Concept illustration of clinical claims linked to highlighted evidence and citations.

publications.title: StableAML: Machine Learning for Behavioral Wallet Detection in Stablecoin Anti-Money Laundering on Ethereum
publications.description:
Open-access journal article with Luciano Juvinski and Alessio Brini (Duke Pratt School of Engineering), published in Blockchain, Vol. 4, Issue 2, Art. 0007 (2026).

Over $3.1T of illicit money moves through the global financial system yearly — increasingly via stablecoins. Using on-chain USDT/USDC transaction data on Ethereum, the study benchmarks linear models, tree ensembles, deep networks, and graph neural networks for behavioral wallet detection. Tree ensembles come out on top, cleanly separating distinct illicit patterns such as cybercrime and sanctioned wallets — sharpening know-your-transaction (KYT) compliance precision under the EU's MiCA and the U.S. GENIUS Act.

DOI: 10.55092/blockchain20260007

notes.title: DeepSeek Tech Tree — from GPT to DeepSeek-V4.1
notes.description: A 21-lesson course that starts from one forward pass of a standard GPT and follows every DeepSeek technical report to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: MLA, DeepSeekMoE, GRPO, FP8 training, R1, sparse attention, mHC and the million-token V4 line. Each innovation is derived step by step, priced in bytes and FLOPs, and traced to its paper. Comes with an 11-lesson math refresher.

notes.title: Lesson 1 · Transformer Anatomy (Feynman edition)
notes.description: Lesson 1 of the DeepSeek course, rebuilt around the Feynman technique: write what you think before the lesson, teach each page back in plain words under constraints, check against a list, and replay the whole lesson on a closing review page. A built-in button asks Claude to find the gaps in your own explanation.
